mapper.select: SELECT t3.question_id, t3.subject_id, t3.question_score, t3.question_difficulty, t3.question_type, t3.question_title, t3.question_answer, t3.`option`, t3.`explain` FROM ms_random_test AS t1 JOIN ms_random_test_question AS t2 ON t1.random_test_id = t2.random_test_id AND t2.del_flag = 0 JOIN ms_question AS t3 ON t2.question_id = t3.question_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 WHERE t1.del_flag = 0 AND t1.random_test_id = #{randomTestId}
select COUNT(*) FROM ms_question t1 WHERE t1.subject_id = #{subjectId}

SELECT t1.question_id, t1.subject_id, t1.question_score, t1.question_difficulty, t1.question_title, t1.question_type, t1.question_answer, t1.`option`, t1.`explain` FROM ms_question t1 WHERE t1.question_id = #{questionId} AND t1.del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ms_test_question WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date , COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) AS question_sum FROM ms_question GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ;
